title: Authorising Covert Surveillance, 2016–2021
grammar: Recap: obligation in the past with köteles volt and kénytelen volt
goal: I can describe how covert surveillance was authorised and what the European Court of Human Rights found in 2016, with dates (*engedélyezés, garancia, magánélet*).
I can say what a rule required in the past with *köteles volt* and *kénytelen volt* (*a szolgálatok kötelesek voltak engedélyt kérni*).
I can report how the government and a human rights organisation judged the system.
